// Implementation-time forwarding recorder: every payload comes from the node.
type recordRun struct {
	name    string
	cleanup []func()
}

func (r *recordRun) Helper()                      {}
func (r *recordRun) Name() string                 { return r.name }
func (r *recordRun) Cleanup(f func())             { r.cleanup = append(r.cleanup, f) }
func (r *recordRun) Fatal(args ...any)            { panic(fmt.Sprint(args...)) }
func (r *recordRun) Fatalf(f string, args ...any) { panic(fmt.Sprintf(f, args...)) }
func (r *recordRun) Error(args ...any)            { panic(fmt.Sprint(args...)) }
func (r *recordRun) close() {
	for i := len(r.cleanup) - 1; i >= 0; i-- {
		r.cleanup[i]()
	}
}
func repair37Root(r *recordRun) string {
	root, err := filepath.Abs("../../../..")
	if err != nil {
		r.Fatal(err)
	}
	return root
}

type repairM948RPCCall struct {
	Method        string
	Params        json.RawMessage `json:",omitempty"`
	Result        json.RawMessage
	Error         json.RawMessage
	Notifications []json.RawMessage
}
type repairM948Replay struct {
	mu       sync.Mutex
	calls    []*repairM948RPCCall
	server   *httptest.Server
	endpoint string
	peers    map[*websocket.Conn]bool
	name     string
}

func newRepairM948Replay(r *recordRun) *repairM948Replay {
	s := &repairM948Replay{peers: map[*websocket.Conn]bool{}, name: "emitter-rpc.json"}
	if strings.Contains(r.Name(), "BeaconOwnershipHandoff") {
		s.name = "beacon-rpc.json"
	} else if strings.Contains(r.Name(), "NativeExecutorNode") {
		s.name = "native-node-rpc.json"
	}
	upgrader := websocket.Upgrader{}
	s.server = httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, req *http.Request) {
		downstream, err := upgrader.Upgrade(w, req, nil)
		if err != nil {
			r.Fatal(err)
		}
		upstream, _, err := websocket.DefaultDialer.Dial(os.Args[1], nil)
		if err != nil {
			r.Fatal(err)
		}
		s.mu.Lock()
		s.peers[downstream] = true
		s.mu.Unlock()
		defer func() { downstream.Close(); upstream.Close(); s.mu.Lock(); delete(s.peers, downstream); s.mu.Unlock() }()
		pending := map[string]*repairM948RPCCall{}
		var last *repairM948RPCCall
		go func() {
			for {
				_, raw, err := upstream.ReadMessage()
				if err != nil {
					downstream.Close()
					return
				}
				var response struct {
					ID     json.RawMessage `json:"id"`
					Result json.RawMessage `json:"result"`
					Error  json.RawMessage `json:"error"`
				}
				if err = json.Unmarshal(raw, &response); err != nil {
					r.Fatal(err)
				}
				s.mu.Lock()
				if len(response.ID) > 0 {
					call := pending[string(response.ID)]
					if call == nil {
						r.Fatal("unmatched upstream response")
					}
					call.Result = response.Result
					call.Error = response.Error
					last = call
					delete(pending, string(response.ID))
				} else {
					if last == nil {
						r.Fatal("notification without preceding call")
					}
					last.Notifications = append(last.Notifications, json.RawMessage(append([]byte(nil), raw...)))
				}
				s.mu.Unlock()
				if err = downstream.WriteMessage(websocket.TextMessage, raw); err != nil {
					return
				}
			}
		}()
		for {
			_, raw, err := downstream.ReadMessage()
			if err != nil {
				return
			}
			var request struct {
				ID     json.RawMessage `json:"id"`
				Method string          `json:"method"`
				Params json.RawMessage `json:"params"`
			}
			if err = json.Unmarshal(raw, &request); err != nil {
				r.Fatal(err)
			}
			call := &repairM948RPCCall{Method: request.Method, Params: request.Params}
			s.mu.Lock()
			s.calls = append(s.calls, call)
			pending[string(request.ID)] = call
			s.mu.Unlock()
			if err = upstream.WriteMessage(websocket.TextMessage, raw); err != nil {
				r.Fatal(err)
			}
		}
	}))
	s.endpoint = "ws" + strings.TrimPrefix(s.server.URL, "http")
	return s
}
func (s *repairM948Replay) Close() error {
	s.mu.Lock()
	for p := range s.peers {
		p.Close()
	}
	s.mu.Unlock()
	s.server.Close()
	hashes := map[string]string{}
	for _, name := range []string{"EventEmitter", "ERC1967Proxy", "PoolBeacon"} {
		raw, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join("testdata", "repair37", name+".json"))
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		hashes[name] = fmt.Sprintf("%x", sha256.Sum256(raw))
	}
	revision, err := os.ReadFile("testdata/repair_m948/producer-revision.txt")
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	sourceHashes := map[string]string{}
	if s.name == "native-node-rpc.json" {
		root, err := filepath.Abs("../../../..")
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		for _, path := range []string{"precompiles/launchpad/events.go", "precompiles/launchpad/router.go", "precompiles/launchpad/fees.go", "precompiles/launchpad/nft.go", "precompiles/launchpad/run.go", "modules/launchpad/keeper/keeper.go", "node/testdata/v6120-halt-export.json"} {
			raw, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(root, path))
			if err != nil {
				return err
			}
			sourceHashes[path] = fmt.Sprintf("%x", sha256.Sum256(raw))
		}
	}
	s.mu.Lock()
	defer s.mu.Unlock()
	for _, call := range s.calls {
		if len(call.Result) == 0 && len(call.Error) == 0 {
			return fmt.Errorf("incomplete %s", call.Method)
		}
	}
	raw, err := json.MarshalIndent(struct {
		Revision       string
		ArtifactHashes map[string]string
		SourceHashes   map[string]string
		Calls          []*repairM948RPCCall
	}{strings.TrimSpace(string(revision)), hashes, sourceHashes, s.calls}, "", "  ")
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return os.WriteFile(filepath.Join("testdata", "repair_m948", s.name), append(raw, '\n'), 0644)
}
func main() {
	for _, scenario := range []struct {
		name string
		run  func(*recordRun)
	}{
		{"BeaconOwnershipHandoff", recordBeaconOwnershipHandoff},
		{"RetainedEmitterV2", recordRetainedEmitterV2},
		{"NativeExecutorNode", recordNativeExecutorNode},
	} {
		if len(os.Args) > 2 && os.Args[2] != scenario.name {
			continue
		}
		r := &recordRun{name: scenario.name}
		func() { defer r.close(); scenario.run(r) }()
		fmt.Println("recorded", scenario.name)
	}
}
